## Features
- String lights waterproof black rubber cable
- Flexible strong weatherproof cable easy install
- Energy efficient led bulbs warm cool rgb options

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

5903781.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Dreamy Christmas light
- Amazing infinity tunnel effect
- UK mains powered with 5m cable
- Designed for easy hanging
- Double-sided for front and back viewing

## Information
Delight and amaze your guests in equal measure with our Christmas Wreath Infinity Light. Beautifully lighted by colourful LEDs, it measures 60cm and is perfect for indoor display. When turned on, mirrors reflect the LEDs, creating a never-ending reflection of the wreath. Fun, bright, and colourful, it's perfect for pairing with other infinity lights from our collection. The Christmas infinity tunnel light is mains powered rather than battery powered to produce a brighter glow. Powered by an IP20-rated UK 3-pin transformer plug for indoor sockets only. The plug has 5m cable which is clear to blend in more discreetly with its surroundings. At 5m long, it gives you plenty of flexibility when displaying the wreath on a door, shelf, or windowsill. In our view, no image can do our infinity light justice. By creating an infinite tunnel of light, the mirrors and LEDs produce a spectacular 3D effect. Perfect for giving your home the wow factor at Christmas. Hanging the wreath on a door A small gap above its bow allows you to easily hook it onto a wreath hanger. As an indoor decoration, it's only suitable for front doors well sheltered by a porch or roof.

## Information
NETTA mains-powered cluster string lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor use and provide a bright decorative lighting effect for Christmas and other occasions. Featuring warm white and cool white lighting, multiple lighting modes with memory function and a convenient automatic timer, these lights are easy to install and operate. The dark green cable blends naturally with Christmas trees and outdoor greenery, making the lights ideal for Christmas displays, parties, weddings, gardens and other seasonal decorations.
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your tree shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Warm White & Cool White Christmas Cluster Lights that feature 480 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash.
